description: Per-ACTIVE-SITE catalytic-metal reasoning keyed by mechanism/family. The value is per catalytic site; the resolver multiplies by the number of active sites modeled (oligomeric state). A raw UniProt metal tally is only a cross-check, never the placement count, because it conflates per-subunit vs per-assembly and binding-site-label artifacts.

acyl_adenylate.rationale: ANL adenylate-forming ligases use a single catalytic Mg2+ that bridges the ATP alpha-phosphate during adenylate formation.

acyl_phosphate.rationale: Two-metal-assisted phosphoryl transfer (e.g. glutamine-synthetase / ATP-grasp ligases) positions two divalent cations per active site.

default.rationale: Conservative single catalytic divalent metal when family/mechanism is unresolved.
